Alex (PM): Quick sync — finalizing rollout plan for 'multi-model routing' (latency+cost steering). Need alignment on feature flags, canary cohorts, A/B knobs, and fallback order before ops sync tomorrow. Outline below; please react or reply with objections.

Alex (PM): Proposed plan:
- Phase 1: regional blue/green warmup (US -> EU -> APAC) with 0.5% traffic canaries per region for 24h
- Phase 2: expand canary to 5% with A/B weight test (control = current router, variant = cost-aware router) for 72h
- Traffic routing fallback order: full model -> quantized model -> smaller model -> local replica fallback
- Flags: global rollout flag + per-region opt-in + per-tenant exemption flag
- Killchain: manual pause + automated rollback if p99 latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 3x baseline for 30m

Maria (SRE): +1 to regional order. Question: can we reduce canary window in APAC because of lower traffic?

Devin (Eng): We can. Suggest APAC canary 1% for 48h then 5%. US/EU keep 0.5%->5% flow. Also: prefer gradual CPU quota bump to avoid noisy neighbors.

Tara (Metrics): Telemetry gating: we need 3 signal groups: latency (p50/p95/p99), correctness (response deltas on eval prompts), and perf (tokens/sec + GPU util). Propose hard gate on p99 and weighted alert on correctness.

Sam (Security): Per-tenant exemption flag ok. Need to confirm KMS hoisting for Private customers — any routing change must keep key usage isolated. Also confirm no new PII flows for shadow routing.

Lina (CS): Heads-up: two enterprise customers requested early opt-in. They require a two-week notice, and one needs a private rollback hook. We should list onboarding steps for customer opt-in in the runbook.

Noah (Legal): If we enable per-tenant opt-ins, add clause for change notifications in contract addenda. Also log retention for these tenants must be 90d for audit.

Chris (Release): Timeline check: can we get a gated feature flag + runbook ready by Wednesday? I can schedule a maintenance window Friday for Phase 1 if team signs off.

Devin (Eng): I can prepare the flags and the scripts for automated rollback (deploy-bot will run them). Need SRE signoff on autoscale boundaries.

Maria (SRE): I'll provide autoscale thresholds and a flamegraph template for post-canary. Also propose a staggered rollout hours window: 03:00-09:00 UTC for EU to minimize user impact.

Tara (Metrics): For the A/B, define success metrics: delta in cost per 1k tokens < -10% (i.e., cost savings) AND mean latency change <= +5ms; else fail. We'll do an early stop if correctness regresses >1%.

Alex (PM): Good. Decision checkpoints: 
1) Preflight: feature flag + runbook + customer opt-in list ready (owner: Chris)
2) Canary day: SRE monitors gates; metrics owner (Tara) gives go/no-go at 12h and 24h
3) Expand: after 72h stable, lift to 20% and start gradual regional ramp

Alex (PM): Edge cases: 
- If a dedicated tenant opts in but shows >2x baseline latency, immediate opt-out and isolated rollback for that tenant.
- If global capacity drops (NVMe queue > 80% or GPU throttle > 70%), fallback to smaller model and enable extra caching for 10m.

Sam (Security): Add a checklist item: verify that routing decision logs are scrubbed before they hit S3 for EU tenants.

Lina (CS): I'll draft the customer opt-in email template and the steps for private rollback. Will share by EOD.

Noah (Legal): I'll draft the contract addendum language and share with Lina.

Devin (Eng): One more: flag names and burn-in commands. Proposed:
```
FLAG_MULTI_MODEL_ROUTING = on/off
FLAG_MMR_REGION_OVERRIDE = us/eu/apac/*
FLAG_MMR_TENANT_EXEMPT = tenant_id list
```
Will add a doc link to ops playbook.

Maria (SRE): I added a small automation: if p99 > 2x baseline for 15m and p50 degraded > 20% then we demote weight by 50% automatically and alert oncall. Is everyone ok with that tuning?

Tara (Metrics): Fine with automation as long as we record the decision in the runbook and surface the trigger in dashboards.

Chris (Release): I'll attach the runbook to the release ticket. @deploy-bot make sure rollbacks are idempotent.

deploy-bot: queued rollback job template verified (job-id: rollout-1791234567-rollback).

Alex (PM): Final asks before I call this plan 'go': owners for preflight checklist (Chris), metrics dashboard (Tara), runbook author (Devin), oncall SRE for canary weekend (Maria), customer comms (Lina), legal addenda (Noah). Please confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:

Maria (SRE): I confirm oncall.

Devin (Eng): I'll own runbook authoring and flag PR.

Tara (Metrics): I own dashboards and gating queries.

Chris (Release): Preflight checklist owner here.

Lina (CS): Customer comms owner.

Noah (Legal): I'll draft addenda.

Alex (PM): Great — closing thread. If anything changes ping this thread or DM. Thanks! :rocket:
